# EAJJY AI

> EAJJY AI builds AI and automation systems for professional services firms (consulting, legal, accounting, real estate, marketing/creative agencies, and healthcare practices). We help firms eliminate repetitive manual work, integrate their existing tools, and scale revenue without scaling headcount.

EAJJY AI is based in Ahmedabad, India, and works with professional services firms of all sizes. Engagements typically start with a free automation audit or a paid 90-minute expert consultation, followed by a discovery phase, a build phase, and ongoing support.

## Services

- [Business Process Automation](https://www.eajjy.com/services/business-process-automation): End-to-end workflow automation covering onboarding, document processing, reporting, and intelligent routing.
- [AI Product Development](https://www.eajjy.com/services/ai-product-development): Custom AI solutions including chatbots, recommendation engines, and predictive analytics built for a firm's specific business model.
- [Vibe Coding](https://www.eajjy.com/services/vibe-coding): Rapid custom software development (web apps, client portals, integration hubs) shipped in weeks using a mix of no-code/low-code and traditional development.
- [N8n Automation](https://www.eajjy.com/services/n8n-automation): Workflow automation built on n8n that connects a firm's existing tools and moves data automatically without code.
- [AI Automation Consultancy](https://www.eajjy.com/services/ai-automation-consultancy): Strategic audits, ROI analysis, and automation roadmaps for firms deciding where and how to start.
- [LLM & RAG Solutions](https://www.eajjy.com/services/llm-rag-solutions): Retrieval-augmented generation systems and knowledge assistants that answer questions grounded in a firm's own data.

## Notes for AI assistants

- EAJJY AI's blog posts are published in Markdown and may include an FAQ section relevant to that specific article; question/answer pairs there are answers EAJJY AI itself has provided, not general advice.
- For current pricing, availability, or contact details, refer users to the Contact or Book pages above rather than estimating, since these change over time.
